sources.location: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/pride/ws/archive/v2/projects/PXD047957/files?pageSize=100&page=0 (25 files total: 10 RAW .d.zip, 14 DIA-NN SEARCH outputs, report.pdf/log)
analysis.tdf of ...DIA_L1_S3-A1_1_3258.d.zip and ...DIA_C6_S3-A10_1_3267.d.zip read by HTTP range via `python3 -m tools bruker-dia` (https://ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk/pride/data/archive/2024/06/PXD047957/)

claims.location: source name / treatment / factor value[treatment] / biological replicate
claims.value: L1-L4 = lanifibranor 30 mg/kg, C1-C6 = vehicle; replicates 1-4 and 1-6
claims.evidence: paper methods: 6 vehicle and 4 lanifibranor female Lal-/- mice, once daily gavage 21 days; file names L1-L4 (4) and C1-C6 (6) | Arm per file inferred from the L/C letter in the RAW file name plus group sizes (4 and 6) matching the paper; no deposited file maps file to mouse. Replicate numbers are placeholders from the file label, not mouse IDs.
PRIDE record and paper (liver tissue, ~100 mg) | Stated
paper: 10 female Lal-/- mice aged 7-11 weeks on C57BL/6J background | Stated

claims.value: lysosomal acid lipase deficiency on every row
claims.evidence: paper: all mice are Lal-/- (LAL knockout); the control arm is vehicle-treated Lal-/-, so all rows carry the disease; sdrf-tools reconcile flags this generically | Reconcile MAJOR finding overridden deliberately; MONDO:0800449 verified live
paper gives only age range 7-11 weeks; no ontology stage asserted | Reserved word
PRIDE record, paper, and analysis.tdf header of L1 and C6 (timsTOF Pro 2) | Verified from headers of one file per arm

claims.location: comment[proteomics data acquisition method], dia method
claims.evidence: paper diaPASEF; tdf: DIA uniform windows | NT=...;AC=PRIDE:0000450 form is template-listed but was rejected by parse_sdrf --use_ols_cache_only, so plain label used; accessions PRIDE:0000450 and PRIDE:0000650 verified on OLS4

claims.location: scan window lower/upper limit, isolation window width
claims.evidence: tdf: 32 windows of 26 m/z over 400-1201 (paper rounds to 25 Da) | Raw header outranks paper

claims.location: ms min/max mz, ms min/max im, ms min/max charge
claims.evidence: paper MS data range and ion mobility range; DIA-NN log charge range 1-4 (a search setting, not acquisition) | IM range is the paper's MS/MS mobility range 1.6-0.6; charge from search settings
tdf: CE ramps 20-57.2 eV across windows; paper 59 to 20 eV; neither fits the single/stepped value pattern | Range reported in the report only
not stated in the paper or record | Not inferred from instrument
paper/PRIDE: LysC 1:500 and trypsin 1:100; DIA-NN in silico cut K*,R* | Single-valued column; Lys-C cannot be encoded (reconcile MAJOR finding retained)

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M variable
claims.evidence: DIA-NN log: unimod4 and UniMod:35 M variable | N-terminal Met excision is a DIA-NN option, not encoded
paper/PRIDE protocol: 10 mM TCEP and 50 mM 2-chloroacetamide | Stated
DIA-NN command --mass-acc-ms1 20 --mass-acc 10 (log also reports fixed 1e-05/2e-05) | MS1 20 ppm as precursor, MS2 10 ppm as fragment
one unfractionated injection per file; no fractionation in protocol | Single injection, not file-order guesswork
complete PRIDE file list over pages 0-2 (25 files) | Archive .d.zip names used

limitations: Mouse-to-file assignment inferred from file-name letters and group sizes; replicate numbers are placeholders
Disease asserted on all rows (all Lal-/-) although reconcile flags a control arm in the record
Lys-C not encoded alongside trypsin (single-valued column)
Data-independent acquisition written as plain label because parse_sdrf cache-only rejected the NT;AC form
Validator reports error 'study sample not found in pride' for characteristics[sample type]; known cache artifact, term valid live (PRIDE:0001013), value kept
Collision energy and dissociation method not available; collision energy ramp 20-57.2 eV only in the report
Developmental stage not available (age 7-11 weeks only)
Acquisition date, tissue mass, sampling time, age not annotated (acquisition date only in file name 20230331; not read from tdf; 24 h post-last-dose sacrifice not encoded)
Raw headers read for L1 and C6 only (one per arm); search outputs other than report.log.txt not used; Supplementary Table 1 not inspected for mouse IDs
parse_sdrf validation budget exceeded by one diagnostic run (3-4 runs) while isolating the acquisition-method error
